title: About DarGlobal | Difference Between DarGlobal and Wasalt
text:
About DarGlobal:
DarGlobal (Dar Global PLC) is an international real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). Founded as the international development division of Dar Al Arkan (a major Saudi Arabian real estate enterprise), DarGlobal focuses exclusively on creating ultra-luxury branded residences, holiday homes, and second-home developments in top international tourist and investment hubs. DarGlobal operates globally with premier projects in the United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Oman, Qatar, Spain (Costa del Sol), Bosnia, and the United Kingdom. It is famous for exclusive co-branding agreements with luxury houses including Missoni, Pagani, Elie Saab, Automobili Lamborghini, and the Trump Organization.

Difference Between DarGlobal and Wasalt:
- Business Model & Nature of Platform:
  * DarGlobal is an international real estate developer and asset creator. It designs, develops, builds, and sells its own exclusive luxury residential and mixed-use projects in global destinations.
  * Wasalt (wasalt.sa) is a comprehensive Saudi Arabian property marketplace and digital portal. Wasalt is an online real estate platform that lists thousands of properties for sale, rent, and auction across Saudi Arabia (such as Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, and Al Khobar).
- Geographic Scope:
  * DarGlobal develops international properties outside Saudi Arabia (Dubai, Oman, Spain, Qatar, London).
  * Wasalt is primarily focused on the domestic real estate market within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
- Audience & Listings:
  * DarGlobal serves global affluent investors and second-home buyers seeking branded luxury villas, penthouses, and golf estates.
  * Wasalt caters to domestic homebuyers, renters, commercial tenants, real estate brokers, and local certified developers across Saudi Arabia looking to buy, rent, or auction apartments, villas, and land.

title: AIDA 360 by DarGlobal | Luxury Gated Community & Trump International Golf Club Oman
text:
AIDA is an extraordinary master-planned coastal destination developed by DarGlobal, perched over 130 meters above the shores of the Gulf of Oman in Yiti, Muscat. Spanning over 3.5 million square meters of pristine clifftop terrain, AIDA offers an unmatched blend of luxury, natural beauty, and world-class architectural design.

Key Amenities at Aida 360:
- Trump International Golf Club Oman: A premier 18-hole championship golf course offering spectacular clifftop holes overlooking the sea, state-of-the-art golf academy, and luxury clubhouse.
- Clifftop Promenade & Viewing Decks: Scenic pedestrian trails and lookouts providing 360-degree panoramic views of the ocean, mountains, and coastal cliffs.
- Cliff-Hanging Nightlife & Dining: World-class signature restaurants, lounges, and social clubs situated on dramatic canyon edges.
- Wellness Centers & Spas: Holistic wellness retreats, fitness studios, thermal pools, and tranquil relaxation zones.
- Outdoor Recreation: Extensive hiking and running trails, mountain biking paths, and curated desert nature walks.
- Private Swimming Pools & Infinity Pools: Clifftop infinity pools with horizon sea views.
- 5-Star Boutique Hotels & Hospitality: Ultra-luxury hospitality accommodations and bespoke concierge services for residents and international guests.

Residential Offerings:
AIDA features an exclusive collection of luxury 3-bedroom, 4-bedroom, 5-bedroom, 6-bedroom, and 7-bedroom villas, cliffside ocean mansions, and designer branded apartments. Every residence is meticulously crafted with premium materials, open-concept indoor-outdoor living spaces, private gardens, and floor-to-ceiling windows to capture the dramatic ocean and canyon vistas.

title: DarGlobal Residential Projects | Luxury Branded Second Homes Portfolio
text:
DarGlobal is a premier international real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). DarGlobal specializes in high-end luxury residential developments, branded second homes, and vacation residences in iconic global destinations.

Overview of DarGlobal's Key Residential Projects:
1. Urban Oasis by Missoni (Dubai, United Arab Emirates): Located on the prestigious Dubai Water Canal, Urban Oasis features waterfront 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses with bespoke interiors designed by renowned Italian fashion house Missoni.
2. DaVinci Tower by Pagani (Downtown Dubai, UAE): An ultra-luxury residential skyscraper featuring geometric aesthetics and automotive-inspired interiors designed by Horacio Pagani. Overlooks Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Canal.
3. DG1 Living (Dubai Canal, Business Bay, UAE): Modern luxury residences designed by Gensler architects offering contemporary 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences with sweeping views of the canal and Downtown Dubai skyline.
4. W Residences Dubai - Downtown (Dubai, UAE): Exclusive branded residences managed by Marriott International's luxury W Hotels brand, providing residents with 5-star hospitality, hotel-style amenities, and direct views of Burj Khalifa.
5. AIDA (Muscat, Oman): Oceanfront clifftop community featuring luxury villas, mansions, and residences surrounding the Trump International Golf Club Oman.
6. Les Vagues by Elie Saab (Qetaifan Island North, Qatar): Premium beachfront residential development featuring 1, 2, and 3-bedroom luxury apartments with interiors styled by Lebanese haute couture designer Elie Saab.
7. Tierra Viva (Benahavis, Costa del Sol, Spain): Exclusive gated enclave of ultra-luxury villas located near Marbella, featuring architectural concepts and interiors directly inspired by Automobili Lamborghini.

DarGlobal projects are distinguished by strategic prime locations, partnerships with global luxury brands, high capital appreciation potential, and bespoke lifestyle amenities.

title: DarGlobal Dubai Residential Properties | Flats, Waterfront Towers and Penthouses
text:
DarGlobal's flagship United Arab Emirates portfolio features world-class residential towers and luxury flats situated along the Dubai Water Canal and Downtown Dubai.

Major Developments in Dubai:
- Urban Oasis by Missoni: Located in Business Bay along the waterfront of the Dubai Canal. Offers luxury 1, 2, 3-bedroom waterfront flats and exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses with private elevators and Missoni Home interiors. Starting prices during developer launch ranged from approximately AED 1,200,000 for 1-bedroom apartments to higher tiers for waterfront penthouses.
- DaVinci Tower by Pagani: Located directly on the Dubai Canal overlooking Burj Khalifa. Ultra-luxury branded apartments featuring bespoke Pagani materials, private carbon-fiber detailing, and sweeping canal views.
- DG1 Living: Located at Business Bay / Dubai Canal, featuring contemporary architectural design and luxury apartments.
- W Residences Dubai - Downtown: Branded hotel-serviced apartments offering panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai.

Note Regarding Dubai Marina vs Dubai Canal:
DarGlobal's primary developments in Dubai are concentrated along the Dubai Water Canal, Business Bay, and Downtown Dubai. DarGlobal is a developer of new landmark projects and does not operate an open brokerage exchange for general secondary market flats in Dubai Marina. Consequently, verified pricing for general resale flats in Dubai Marina is not included in DarGlobal's developer catalog; buyers looking for secondary market apartments in Dubai Marina typically consult third-party UAE broker portals, whereas DarGlobal provides off-plan and newly delivered branded residences in its own towers.
